question: 전압 선택 스위치의 공장 출하 시 설정은 얼마인가요?

result.answer: 전압 선택 스위치의 공장 출하 시 설정은 230V 입니다.

citations.text:
Checking to see if you have a dual voltage Lifestyle® ampliﬁer
• Dual voltage units have a voltage selection switch on the rear panel (Figure 15). Check to see if your unit has this switch.
• This switch is preset at the factory to 230V. If you plan to connect your ampliﬁer to 115V (North America), slide this switch to the 115V position.
